summary: Today’s tone is broadly risk-on in equities and selectively bullish in crypto, with Reuters highlighting gains on trade-progress hopes and multiple crypto outlets pointing to strong ETH strength and renewed altcoin speculation. Sentiment is mixed beneath the surface: Bitcoin is still treated as a range trade, while several altcoins and a few large-cap names are being flagged for momentum or event-driven setups.

signals.name: Bitcoin
signals.reason: Across the Sept. 10-11 CPI videos, DegenDave repeatedly framed BTC as a long setup into CPI, including waiting for a 75k touch, starting a long on BTC, and saying you would regret not longing Bitcoin before CPI.
signals.chart_pattern: CPI dip-buy / bullish rebound from support
